claim: EndpointMetadata.RankIndex is not populated from any Kubernetes label convention (no 'llm-d.ai/rank' or 'dp-rank' label field exists); it is defined structurally as the endpoint's positional index within the discovery source's configured EndpointPool.TargetPorts list.
stance_target: whether RankIndex has a label-based carrier that a non-k8s discovery plugin must replicate
scope_conditions: llm-d-router pkg/epp/framework/interface/datalayer, HEAD as of Sep 2026
quoted_support: RankIndex is this endpoint's position in the pool's TargetPorts, identifying the pod-local rank in multi-port deployments.

claim: llm-d-router's own EndpointMetadata struct explicitly documents NodeAddress as empty for non-Kubernetes discovery sources, naming 'file discovery' by example, confirming file-based discovery is a first-party recognized concept in the framework's own source comments, not merely a hypothetical extension point.
stance_target: feasibility of a non-k8s / file-based EndpointDiscovery plugin
quoted_support: NodeAddress is the node IP hosting this pod (pod.Status.HostIP). Empty for non-Kubernetes discovery sources (e.g. file discovery).

claim: EndpointMetadata.ID aliases Kubernetes' types.NamespacedName specifically so that endpoint identity can later be decoupled from the Kubernetes-specific type without changing datastore keys, and every discovery source (including custom/non-k8s ones) must set ID uniquely.
stance_target: how portable the endpoint identity type is for non-k8s backends
quoted_support: ID uniquely identifies an endpoint. It aliases types.NamespacedName so the identity can later move off the Kubernetes-specific type without churning datastore keys. Every discovery source must set it uniquely.
